```{r mapa_peru, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=9}
library(ggOceanMaps)
library(ggplot2)

basemap(limits = c(-85, -70, -30, 0),   # lon min, lon max, lat min, lat max
        bathymetry = TRUE,
        bathy.style = "rbb",            # raster por intervalos en azules
        land.col = "grey35",            # tierra gris oscuro
        land.border.col = NA,           # sin contorno de costa
        grid.col = NA,                  # sin líneas de grilla
        lon.interval = 5, lat.interval = 5) +
  # Recuadro en Callao (~12.05 °S, 77.15 °W)
  annotate("rect", xmin = -77.6, xmax = -76.7, ymin = -12.5, ymax = -11.6,
           fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  annotate("text", x = -76.3, y = -12.05, label = "Callao, Peru",
           hjust = 0, colour = "white", size = 5) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
        legend.position.inside = c(0.82, 0.80),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(colour = "white"),
        legend.text  = element_text(colour = "white"))
```
